82:t_012:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whew... they're tough, these space monsters.」

82:t_012:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If we struggle against a guy this weak, we'll never make it from here on out. There are even bigger ones, you know!」

82:t_012:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Still, somehow they felt different to fight than the type we've faced so far...」

82:t_012:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Maybe they're space monsters too, but something different from a parallel world.」

82:t_012:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...That completes the mission. Well... shall we head back to $$メガネビュラ$$?」

82:t_012:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Is that pink-haired girl from earlier on your mind?」

82:t_012:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Wait, $$姫$$...! There's still one left!」

82:t_013:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Damn! There are people over there!」

82:t_013:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$店長$$'s leg... is under the steel beam...!」

82:t_013:5.en:
$$店長$$
「It's impossible, $$ノノ$$! No matter how freakishly strong you are, you can't move this!」

82:t_013:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ugh...! No! $$ノノリリ$$ wouldn't give up!」

82:t_013:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll make a miracle happen with hard work and guts, I just know it!!」

82:t_013:8.en:
$$店長$$
「Face reality! There are things in this world that can't be done!」

82:t_013:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No way...! I'm absolutely going to save you! I'll save you... and then...!」

82:t_015:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No way...! That girl... she moved the steel beam!」

82:t_015:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Run! A space monster is coming!」

82:t_016:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Damn! That girl's been snagged by the space monster!」

82:t_016:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「No, $$ディスヌフ$$! Don't let it take her away!!」

82:t_017:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Hold on! I'm coming right now!」

82:t_017:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ will do it too...!」

82:t_019:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Siiis! I did it! $$ノノ$$ did it too!!」

82:t_019:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But I think she'd make interesting material.」

82:t_020:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We're inviting you. To our home... $$メガネビュラ$$.」

82:t_021:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「What the heck were those guys...」

82:t_021:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Not even a word of greeting, and they just left...」

82:t_021:2.en:
$$ボス$$
「$$トップレス$$... a space monster I've never seen before... a cutie who fights with her own body...」

82:t_021:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「They're beings that fall completely outside the framework of our common sense.」

82:t_021:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Since we are near a $$レイライン$$, it is highly likely that $$サイデリアル$$ are in the vicinity. Remaining here is dangerous.」

82:t_021:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return. We are withdrawing from this area.」

82:t_021:6.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain, there is a transmission for this ship. It is a woman claiming to be $$破嵐万丈$$'s agent.」

82:t_021:8.en:
$$ラム$$
「Yes, she gives her name as $$三条レイカ$$.」

82:t_021:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「So Sis $$レイカ$$ is the one here to meet us!」

82:t_021:10.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$... She's $$万丈$$'s assistant.」

82:t_021:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood. From now on, we will follow her instructions.」

82:t_100:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go, $$ディスヌフ$$! Physical Canceller, activate! 《$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$》!」

82:t_101:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「This is just a sideshow until the main event shows up. You'll be my opponent, $$サイデリアル$$.」

82:t_101:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Shall we, $$ヴァンセット$$! 《$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$》!」

82:t_102:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That many space monsters descending into the atmosphere...!」

82:t_102:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Calm down, $$姫$$. This isn't the world we came from.」

82:t_102:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There's no defense system against space monsters here, either. To some extent, it can't be helped.」

82:t_102:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You don't have to say it, I know. This is the most precious planet to humanity... Earth.」

82:t_102:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And whatever world it is, protecting Earth from the space monster threat is the mission of us, the $$トップレス$$.」

82:t_102:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「(That's right... which is why we can't afford to lose... The moment we lose, we become meaningless...)」

82:t_103:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Even if these guys are different from the space monsters we know, if they attack, all we can do is fight them!」

82:t_103:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm used to monster hunting! Me and $$マジンガーＺ$$ will take you on!」

82:t_104:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I never thought space monsters would show up on $$翠の地球$$ too...!」

82:t_104:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「If $$バアル$$ is the enemy, I'll show no mercy! We'll do $$ノリコ$$'s share as well!」

82:t_105:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ノリコ$$ told us. That the fight against space monsters is a fight for survival...!」

82:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then we'll just fight...! I have no intention of dying, and humanity has no intention of going extinct!」

82:t_106:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We talk about $$バアル$$ and space monsters show up... Are we cursed or something...?」

82:t_106:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「This is no time to be saying that! If we leave these things alone, it'll turn into something terrible!」

82:t_107:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't lose, $$鉄人$$! Our opponent is humanity's natural enemy!」

82:t_107:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't flinch, even against an enemy you've never seen! If we lose, the people in that town are in danger!」

82:t_108:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「To think that things like these came to Earth while we were with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$...!」

82:t_108:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「As long as we're here, we won't let them lay a finger on the town! I'll take them all out!」

82:t_109:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Well, well, if it isn't the famous space monsters! The more I look, the more monstrous they are!」

82:t_109:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tough luck, you guys! Our being here was your bad luck...! I'll wipe out every last one!」

82:t_021:0/1: who 'they' are is the Topless pair (scene settles it); written 'those guys' / 'they'
82:t_105:1: 'Then we'll just fight' - 'we' supplied; Sousuke speaks for the squad

お姉さま (Nono to Lal'C) = 'Big Sis'; no settled rendering; レイカの姉ちゃん (Kappei) = 'Sis Reika'
フィジカルキャンセラー = 'Physical Canceller' (not in the glossary, plain text; 《》 link kept only on Exotic Maneuver)
82:t_016:2: 行かせるな - read as 'don't let the monster take her away' (Lal'C to Dix-Neuf); could instead mean 'don't let it go/escape'

イナズマキック = 'Lightning Kick'; Nono's 'Nonoriri' = the legendary pilot she idolizes (Noriko), kept third-person
